prompt: As of July 1, 2024, what is the parent company of the current record label of the singer of Edge of Seventeen?
answer: As of July 1, 2024, **Stevie Nicks**—the singer of “Edge of Seventeen”—was associated with **Rhino Entertainment**, whose parent company is **Warner Music Group (WMG)**.
